title: A pnpm workspace installs frozen and builds only what the change affects in the merge trial
description: The merge trial installs a pnpm workspace (two apps and a shared package linked with workspace:*) with pnpm install --frozen-lockfile through npm exec, then builds the changed packages, their dependents and those packages' dependencies: a change to one app builds the shared package and that app but not the other, a change to the shared package builds all three, and a broken build in the affected app fails the trial. Fetches pnpm from the registry on the first run.

steps.name: a pnpm workspace's trial builds the affected packages and fails on a broken affected build
